rationale: No existing spec covers the new 'Used by' dependency surface. alerts-destinations-prebuilt.spec.js and dl-email-destinations.spec.js exercise destination CRUD/email, and grep for 'used-by'/'dependency-impact' returns no E2E coverage (only unit *.spec.ts under web/src). The run-context specifies spec_path tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-destinations-usage.spec.js, which matches the Alerts area + @alerts shard. A brand-new spec is required, so it must be registered in ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json under the 'Alerts' run_files array.
